newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Pucobre to boost concentrator.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Pucobre to boost concentrator.

text.p: Chilean copper producer Sociedad Punta del Cobre SA, or Pucobre, plans to expand its concentrator to raise production to 33,000 tonnes fine content a year from about 25,000 currently, the company said.
The plans, still under study, will raise capacity at the San Jose concentrator to about 70,000 tonnes of ore a month, said Pucobre vice president Jose Enrique Diez.

"In about two or three months, the study will be finished, and if it comes out all right we'll start work right away. The expansion will take about six months and should come into operation early next year," Diez told Reuters at a shareholders' meeting of Pacifico V Region, owner of 55 percent of Pucobre.
Pucobre is one of only two copper mining companies quoted on the Santiago Stock Exchange and one of the very few in the country that is owned neither by the Chilean state nor foreigners.
